subject: Unconference Recap: Real Insights from AI That Works in Prod
body:
Hello First Name,

Our latest 🦄 ai that works session just wrapped up, and we dove into the "Unconference Recap: Real Insights from AI That Works in Prod"!

The full recording, code, and diagrams from the session are now available on GitHub:
https://github.com/hellovai/ai-that-works

We shared a ton from our recent AI That Works Unconference. Here are some of the biggest lessons we discussed:

*   **Slop Code is Inevitable:** Unattended models *will* generate 'slop code.' It's a given. So, we need smart ways to manage or reduce it.
*   **No Single 'Right' Way:** There's no single 'right' way to build with AI. The landscape is changing so fast that everyone's still experimenting, adapting, and even changing their core approaches every few months.
*   **Evals and Feedback Loops are King:** To improve code quality and push back human intervention, we need solid evaluation systems for skills, deterministic linters, and 'adversarial review' loops.

If there's one thing to take away from this session, it's this: The AI development world is moving incredibly fast. Everyone is still figuring things out, constantly experimenting, and adapting their approaches to build AI that truly works in production.

Next week, Avery will join us for "Measured Slop." He tested 200 agents building the same feature and analyzed their performance. We might even have another speaker from the unconference join us too!

Got questions? Just reply to this email or hop into our Discord: https://www.boundaryml.com/discord. We read every message! Happy coding 🧑‍💻

Vaibhav & Dex
